title: What's new in Python 3.14 (mirror)
snippet: Python 3.14 adds template strings (t-strings), deferred evaluation of annotations and a free-threaded build option.
content: What's new in Python 3.14 (synthetic mirror). Highlights: template string literals (t-strings, PEP 750); deferred evaluation of annotations (PEP 649); official support for the free-threaded build; a new compression.zstd module; improved error messages.
